department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India (through KVIC, KVIB and District Industries Centres)
benefit: Help to start a new small business (not farming). The bank gives a loan and the government pays part of the project cost as a subsidy. General category: 15% in towns, 25% in villages. Special category (SC, ST, OBC, minorities, women, ex-servicemen, transgender, people with disabilities): 25% in towns, 35% in villages. Project cost up to Rs 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs 20 lakh for business or service.

other: For projects above Rs 10 lakh (manufacturing) or Rs 5 lakh (business/service), you must have passed 8th standard.
Only one person per family (you and your spouse).
You put in 10% of the cost yourself (5% for special category).

how_to_apply: Apply online on the KVIC PMEGP e-portal. Click 'Apply' under 'Application For New Unit'. Fill your details, save, upload your papers and submit.
